# ZenRows

ZenRows is a web scraping API allowing developers to bypass CAPTCHAs and blocks, gather structured data from dynamic websites, and quickly integrate results into applications

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/zenrows/.

## Actions

- **Get Concurrency Status** (read-only): This tool retrieves the current concurrency status of your zenrows api usage.
- **Get Detailed Concurrency Status** (read-only): This tool provides detailed information about the current concurrency status and limits of your zenrows account by making a request to the…
- **Get Original Status Code** (read-only): This tool retrieves the original http status code returned by the target website, which is useful for debugging purposes.
- **Get PDF from URL** (read-only): This tool generates a pdf version of the scraped content from a given url.
- **Get Plaintext Response**: This tool extracts plain text content from a webpage using the zenrows api.
- **Get response headers** (read-only): A tool to retrieve and parse response headers from zenrows api requests.
- **Get Response with Compression** (read-only): A tool to fetch content from a url using the zenrows api with compression enabled to optimize bandwidth usage and improve performance.
- **Get Session ID** (read-only): This tool implements zenrows' session management functionality to maintain the same ip address across multiple requests for up to 10…
- **Get Walmart Product Details** (read-only): This tool allows users to extract detailed product information from walmart using zenrows' specialized e-commerce scraping api.
- **Get ZenRows API Usage Statistics** (read-only): This tool retrieves the current api usage statistics and limits for your zenrows account.
- **Scrape url autoparse** (read-only): The zenrows scrape url autoparse tool automatically parses and extracts structured data from any given url using intelligent parsing…
- **Scrape URL HTML** (read-only): This tool extracts raw html data from a given url using zenrows' universal scraper api.
- **Scrape URL with CSS Selectors** (read-only): This tool allows users to scrape specific elements from a webpage using css selectors.
- **Screenshot URL** (read-only): A tool to capture screenshots of web pages using zenrows api.
- **Get Real Estate Property Data** (read-only): A specialized tool for extracting structured data from real estate platforms like zillow and idealista.
- **Scrape url** (read-only): Scrape and extract data from a specified url.
